patterns.title: Plate with centered through hole
patterns.summary: Create a rectangular base and subtract a coaxial cylindrical through hole.
patterns.code:
width, depth, thickness = 60.0, 40.0, 6.0
hole_diameter = 10.0
with BuildPart() as part:
    Box(width, depth, thickness)
    register_feature("base_plate", "Base plate", "additive", part.part)
    Hole(hole_diameter / 2, depth=thickness)
    register_feature("center_hole", "Center hole", "subtractive", part.part, parent_id="base_plate")
result = part.part

patterns.title: Polar mounting-hole pattern
patterns.summary: Distribute equal through holes on a bolt circle with PolarLocations.
patterns.code:
plate_radius, thickness = 40.0, 5.0
bolt_circle_radius, hole_radius = 30.0, 2.0
with BuildPart() as part:
    Cylinder(plate_radius, thickness)
    with PolarLocations(bolt_circle_radius, 6):
        Hole(hole_radius, depth=thickness)
    register_feature("mount_holes", "Mounting holes", "pattern", part.part, parameters={"count": 6})
result = part.part

patterns.title: Rectangular ventilation-hole grid
patterns.summary: Use GridLocations to cut a regular matrix of circular vents.
patterns.code:
with BuildPart() as part:
    Box(80, 50, 4)
    with GridLocations(12, 12, 5, 3):
        Hole(2.5, depth=4)
    register_feature("vent_grid", "Vent grid", "pattern", part.part, parameters={"columns": 5, "rows": 3})
result = part.part

patterns.title: Extruded rounded-rectangle profile
patterns.summary: Build a robust rounded sketch and extrude it into a solid enclosure body.
patterns.code:
with BuildPart() as part:
    with BuildSketch():
        RectangleRounded(70, 45, 6)
    extrude(amount=12)
    register_feature("rounded_body", "Rounded body", "additive", part.part)
result = part.part

patterns.title: Counterbored fastener hole
patterns.summary: Cut a through hole with a cylindrical recess for a socket-head screw.
patterns.code:
with BuildPart() as part:
    Box(40, 30, 10)
    CounterBoreHole(radius=2.5, counter_bore_radius=4.5, counter_bore_depth=3, depth=10)
    register_feature("fastener_hole", "Counterbored fastener hole", "subtractive", part.part)
result = part.part

patterns.title: Countersunk fastener hole

    Box(40, 30, 6)
    CounterSinkHole(radius=2.0, counter_sink_radius=4.0, depth=6)
    register_feature("flush_hole", "Countersunk hole", "subtractive", part.part)

patterns.title: Fillet vertical solid edges
patterns.summary: Apply fillets after robust base geometry using an axis-based edge selector.
patterns.code:
with BuildPart() as part:
    Box(50, 30, 12)
    fillet(part.edges() | Axis.Z, radius=3)
    register_feature("vertical_fillets", "Vertical fillets", "fillet", part.part, parameters={"radius": 3})
result = part.part

patterns.title: Chamfer top perimeter edges
patterns.summary: Select the upper horizontal edge group and apply a manufacturing chamfer.
patterns.code:
with BuildPart() as part:
    Box(50, 30, 12)
    top_edges = part.edges().group_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
    chamfer(top_edges, length=1.5)
    register_feature("top_chamfer", "Top chamfer", "chamfer", part.part, parameters={"length": 1.5})
result = part.part

patterns.title: Plate with an elongated slot
patterns.summary: Sketch a centered slot and subtract its extrusion from a plate.
patterns.code:
with BuildPart() as part:
    Box(70, 35, 5)
    with BuildSketch():
        SlotOverall(30, 8)
    extrude(amount=5, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    register_feature("adjustment_slot", "Adjustment slot", "subtractive", part.part)
result = part.part

patterns.title: Revolved axisymmetric knob
patterns.summary: Create a radial half-profile on XZ and revolve it around the Z axis.
patterns.code:
with BuildPart() as part:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XZ):
        Rectangle(12, 24, align=(Align.MIN, Align.CENTER))
    revolve(axis=Axis.Z)
    register_feature("knob_body", "Revolved knob", "additive", part.part)
result = part.part

patterns.title: Loft between separated profiles
patterns.summary: Create profiles on offset planes and loft a smooth solid transition.
patterns.code:
with BuildPart() as part:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY):
        Circle(18)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(35)):
        RectangleRounded(24, 18, 3)
    loft()
    register_feature("lofted_body", "Lofted transition", "additive", part.part)
result = part.part

patterns.title: Sweep a circular tube along a path
patterns.summary: Build a line path, sketch a normal circular profile, and sweep a solid.
patterns.code:
with BuildPart() as part:
    with BuildLine() as path:
        Polyline((0, 0), (30, 0), (45, 15))
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ):
        Circle(3)
    sweep(path=path.wire)
    register_feature("swept_tube", "Swept tube", "additive", part.part)
result = part.part

patterns.title: Symmetric mirrored mounting tabs
patterns.summary: Create one tab and mirror the additive geometry for bilateral symmetry.
patterns.code:
with BuildPart() as part:
    Box(50, 30, 8)
    with Locations((30, 0, 0)):
        Box(10, 16, 4)
    mirror(about=Plane.YZ)
    register_feature("mount_tabs", "Mirrored mounting tabs", "pattern", part.part)
result = part.part

patterns.title: Four corner mounting bosses
patterns.summary: Place additive cylinders at a rectangular location grid.
patterns.code:
with BuildPart() as part:
    Box(80, 50, 4)
    with GridLocations(60, 30, 2, 2):
        Cylinder(5, 12)
    register_feature("corner_bosses", "Corner bosses", "pattern", part.part, parameters={"count": 4})
result = part.part

patterns.title: Hollow cylindrical sleeve
patterns.summary: Subtract a coaxial inner cylinder to form a constant-thickness sleeve.
patterns.code:
outer_radius, wall, length = 15.0, 2.0, 40.0
with BuildPart() as part:
    Cylinder(outer_radius, length)
    Cylinder(outer_radius - wall, length, mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    register_feature("sleeve_bore", "Sleeve bore", "subtractive", part.part, parameters={"wall": wall})
result = part.part

patterns.title: Transverse cylindrical side port
patterns.summary: Orient a subtractive cylinder along X to cut a port through a body.
patterns.code:
with BuildPart() as part:
    Box(40, 30, 24)
    with Locations((0, 0, 0)):
        Cylinder(4, 40, rotation=(0, 90, 0), mode=Mode.SUBTRACT)
    register_feature("side_port", "Side port", "subtractive", part.part)
result = part.part

patterns.title: Embossed text label
patterns.summary: Create text in a sketch on the top workplane and extrude it additively.
patterns.code:
with BuildPart() as part:
    Box(70, 35, 6)
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY.offset(3)):
        Text("NFNIT", font_size=10)
    extrude(amount=1)
    register_feature("embossed_label", "Embossed label", "additive", part.part)
result = part.part
